content: We need to identify elements based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool to get spectrum. Then analyze isotopic patterns to see which elements show characteristic patterns (e.g., Cl with 3:1 ratio, Br with 1:1, S with 4:1? Actually S has 32,33,34 isotopes with small pattern). Also C shows M+1 peak due to 13C ~1.1% per carbon. H has negligible. N has M+1 ~0.37% per N. O has M+2 due to 18O small. But we need definitive identification based on visible patterns. Likely Cl, Br, S, maybe C? But need to see actual spectrum. Let's retrieve spectrum.
